selection_rule: Minimize total selected-point combined CNF/XOR calls divided by the number of pairs with exactly two independently replayed S3 roots; a zero denominator has infinite cost. Evaluate all eight masks at the selected count on the frozen holdout point.
stop_rule: Terminate each attempt on the first distinct complete pair-1 assignment, an earlier model, or the resource cap; retain failed attempts and charge every selected mask.
host_isolation: none; operation counters are the primary diagnostic and wall/CPU are exploratory
